## Second-teacher review

Please have a second teacher complete this checklist before approving:

- [ ] I reviewed the change and understand what it does.
- [ ] The activity details, dates, links, and contact information are accurate.
- [ ] The content is appropriate for students and the school community.
- [ ] No private student information, passwords, or other secrets were added.
- [ ] The change is readable and accessible, including headings, labels, and mobile layout.
- [ ] I checked that existing activities and links still work.
- [ ] I requested or addressed any necessary follow-up changes.
